Four businesses in this batch (H & J, Amazon General Contractor, Pride, Diversified) have essentially no web presence, so their profiles rest on directory data plus one Google listing; deep audit will need a phone call to confirm.

Pride Construction and Diversified Equities Construction are marked 'not found' because no Google listing or website could be located, not because closure was confirmed. Both may be dormant or trading on referrals alone.
Sticks & Bricks' commercial-roofing scope comes from a search-result summary of its expired domain plus the owner's Google posts, since the site itself could not be opened.
HomeAdvisor, BBB and BuildZoom pages returned HTTP 403 or were not opened directly; details attributed to them come from search-result summaries and should be re-checked in a deep audit.
Scores are consultant judgements for ranking only; ability_to_pay is inferred from business type, age and evidence of size, since no business discloses revenue.
data_gaps: Google review counts not exposed by the limited Maps view for any business in this batch.
No revenue, headcount or state-registration verification for any business.
sticksbricksllc.com and sticksandbrickscommercialroofing.com could not be inspected beyond their error and parking pages, so the prior site's content and search history are unknown.
American General Windows & Renovations' Google Business Profile could not be located by name or phone; it may exist under a variant name.
